summary: When Nora builds a Google Drive or Docs link out of a shared file's short code, it is now read as that code, so the file opens or copies instead of failing as a dead link.
details: Seen live: shown a Google Drive link handle, she made up drive.google.com/file/d/<code> and a folder link, sent them to the web reader, and said she couldn't open the file.
web_fetch and media_fetch point her at the code; file_fetch and computer_import use it directly.
limitations: A made-up link holding two codes is not guessed between.
Why she builds the link at all (the handle says 'link') is not changed here.
